AP.ReflowNoSpace: No safe space and connected access road could be found around this building.
AP.ReflowDone: Building and access road replanned. Check the construction preview.
AP.RotationComingSoon: Building rotation support is planned for a future update.
AP.ParkingAdvisory: Nearby parking is a planning goal, not a placement requirement.
AP.ForcedBuilding: Forced into the plan. Check overlaps and road access in construction preview.
AP.RotationFit: The rotated building does not fit its original editing area.
AP.RotationAccess: Rotation would disconnect the building frontage from its road.
AP.Warning.Protected: Red marks show existing objects protected from deletion. Adjust the entrance or layout.
AP.Warning.Native: Red marks show objects rejected by the game construction check. Orange marks show locations needing inspection, not a confirmed cause.
AP.Warning.Missing: The building preview could not be created at the orange location. Check nearby roads and objects; the cause is not confirmed.
AP.Warning.Frontage: Orange buildings have no suitable road frontage. Check the connecting road. Red marks indicate other confirmed validation failures.
AP.Warning.Parking: Orange parking objects lack a suitable road attachment or vehicle aisle. Red marks indicate other confirmed validation failures.
AP.ShareServerUnavailable: The developer’s diagnostic server is unavailable. Please try later or copy diagnostics.
AP.ShareConsent:
The current diagnostic summary will be stored in the developer’s site database for troubleshooting.
Sent: mod/game versions, error code, editing mode, calculation state, building pattern, object counts, validation metrics and numeric failure details (object types, dimensions and failure conditions).
Not sent: full logs, account names, file paths, asset names, coordinates or save files. A random ID identifies this report only.
Your connection uses HTTPS. The server receives your IP address but stores only a daily HMAC identifier for request limiting, not the raw IP in the diagnostic database. Hosting access logs may separately retain your IP.
No automatic reports. Cancel sends nothing. Do you agree to send?
AP.ShareFailed: Could not confirm receipt. Check your connection or try later. Copy diagnostics remains available.
AP.ShareWait: Too many submissions. Please try later.
AP.AdditionsSlabOnly: Additions currently support slab apartment compounds only.
AP.AdditionSaveLimit: This addition exceeds the compound save budget.
AP.EditCompoundHint: Edit this compound’s plan. Applying it removes the old facilities after confirmation.
AP.CompoundPendingSaved: Changes saved. Start replacement to remove the old facilities after confirmation and preview the revised plan.
AP.NoCompoundAdditions: No additional facilities fit without overlapping existing facilities.
AP.ForceDemolishMessage: Delete the recorded objects of this compound despite preview errors? This cannot be undone. Save your city first. External roads and objects owned by other compounds are preserved; protected objects may remain.
AP.Tower.SelectParking: Choose a parking asset for every entrance.
AP.Tower.AssetHint: Choose a functional underground parking asset. Its original lot and access networks are retained.
AP.Tower.RulesHint: Entrance: four-lane road. Internal roads: Alley. Turnaround: AP one-way transparent road.
AP.Tower.EntranceFit: Not enough space for the selected parking asset and turnaround. Move the gate or choose a smaller asset.
AP.Tower.ConnectionFit: No safe road connection between towers and entrances. Adjust the boundary or selected assets.
AP.Villa.TileLotsHint: Preserve Clip areas, remove other owned surfaces, and place a rotated 16x16 m tile surface. Source assets are unchanged.
AP.Villa.NoThrough: No main road can connect external roads on different sides. Review the approved connections or site.
AP.Villa.EmptyBlock: A road-enclosed block contains no housing. Adjust spacing or the boundary.
AP.Villa.RejectedApproach: Some connections were omitted: no straight or perpendicular approach is available.
AP.Villa.MeshHint: Alley roads serve housing rows. Geometry bounds limit compression; native placement errors remain visible.
AP.Villa.ConnectionHint: Right-click a boundary marker or toggle below to exclude/restore a connection. Red markers stay excluded.
AP.Villa.NoConnection: An approved road connection cannot be reached. Review the perimeter connections or site shape.
AP.LimitParcels: Plan shape limit: requested {current}, maximum {maximum}. Reduce the site size.
AP.LimitParcelsTrimmed: Plan shape limit: generated {current}, maximum {maximum}. Some grass shapes were omitted.
AP.LimitTotalShapes: Total saved shape limit: {current} including this plan / maximum {maximum}. Remove unused saved plans.
AP.LimitSavedPlans: Saved plan limit: {current} including this plan / maximum {maximum}. No unbuilt plans are available for automatic cleanup.
AP.LimitZones: Manual zone limit: {current} including this zone / maximum {maximum}.
AP.LimitRoads: Manual road limit: {current} including this road / maximum {maximum}.
AP.LimitSiteArea: Site area limit: {current} m2 / maximum {maximum} m2.
AP.LimitSiteExtent: Site dimension limit: {current} m / maximum {maximum} m.
AP.GrassSurfacesHint: Add native grass surfaces to small leftover spaces. Separate from Grass Sprites.
AP.TreePlacementHint: The border is within 12 m of the site boundary. Buildings, roads and parking remain excluded.
AP.PanelLoadingHint: This panel is locked until processing completes.
AP.NativeLoadingHint: Controls are locked while roads, buildings and connections are processed.
AP.CatalogLoadingHint: Preparing buildings and roads in small batches. You can close this panel.
AP.CatalogFailed: Asset list could not be prepared. Reopen the panel to retry.
AP.Draw: Click polygon vertices; click the first point or finish to close.
AP.InvalidBoundary: Use a simple polygon of 100-1,000,000 m2, up to 128 points.
AP.PickEntrance: Click a boundary edge to add an entrance. Right-click removes the last entrance.
AP.PickRamp: Click an empty area for the underground parking entrance.
AP.Shortfall: Some targets are unmet. See Summary.
AP.SelectAssets: Choose building assets to include in this plan.
AP.EntranceFit: Entrance does not fit. Choose another edge position or shorten it.
AP.RampFit: Ramp overlaps another zone or leaves the boundary.
AP.NeedBuildings: Select assets and generate building zones before saving.
AP.Limit: Plan display budget reached. Use a smaller site or fewer plans.
AP.Saved: Plan saved. Save the city to retain it after restarting.
AP.Error: Plan command failed; see the ApartmentPlan log.
AP.Keys: Enter: finish drawing. Right-click: undo the current point, then the last added road.
AP.SaveHint: Save the editable plan in this city, then save the city. Select the overlay for details.
AP.AllBuildings: Show all buildings (including custom assets without households)
AP.EstimateHint: FAR uses estimated floors x footprint. Footprint 0 uses the configured lot ratio. Parking capacity counts configured bay widths along connected aisles. These are planning estimates, not statutory checks.
AP.Option.EdgeInfill: Use residual edge space for buildings and parking
AP.Option.WideSlabParking: Wider parking courts for elongated lots
AP.Option.SurfaceParkingShare: Surface share of household parking demand (%)
AP.Option.AlignBlocks: Align building rows and parking courts
AP.Option.RespectTargetFar: Stop placing buildings at target FAR
AP.Option.ParkingSpaceArea: Area per parking space including aisles (m2)
AP.Desc.TargetFar: Used only when the target FAR limit is enabled. Default layout prioritizes residential courts.
AP.Desc.BuildingGap: Minimum end-to-end or perpendicular building gap. Parallel face spacing is set separately.
AP.InvalidAsset: Invalid correction: height 1-1000 m, footprint 0-lot area, households 0-10000.
AP.EditBoundary: Drag a corner or edge. Finish to return to entrance placement.
AP.AccessIncomplete: Some facility footpaths could not be connected. Adjust the layout.
AP.DrawZone: Click zone vertices; Enter or the first point closes it. Right-click undoes a point.
AP.ZoneFit: Zone must be inside the site, at least 100m2, and clear of entrances and other manual zones.
AP.DisconnectedEntrance: No full-width route connects these entrances. Move an entrance or a reserved zone.
AP.PickBuilding: Click a building on the plan.
AP.ChooseReplacement: Choose a replacement asset in the catalog.
AP.ReplacementFit: The new asset is larger than this slot. Choose a smaller asset or regenerate the plan.
AP.Replaced: Building replaced. Recalculating the whole plan resets individual replacements.
AP.Desc.ParallelBuildingGap: Minimum lot-edge gap between parallel buildings whose long faces overlap. Planning clearance, not a legal daylight calculation.
AP.Desc.WideSlabParking: Try larger shared parking courts according to surface parking demand.
AP.Desc.MaxParkingAisles: Maximum shared aisles per court; compact alternatives are tried when space is limited.
AP.Option.MixedBuildingDirections: Mix horizontal and vertical residential groups
AP.Desc.MixedBuildingDirections: Fit reflected and rotated open courts, stagger their bar ends, then fill remaining pockets with both orientations.
AP.Desc.AlignBlocks: Use the configured end-line stagger within each group.
AP.Desc.MainRoadCurveRadius: Preferred corner radius from 8 to 200 m. Short approaches constrain the actual radius; automatic mode may use angular corners.
AP.CurveFit: A road fits, but its corners cannot fit a reasonable curve. Move an entrance or reserved zone.
AP.Option.RequireFrontParking: Require nearby parking for every building
AP.Desc.RequireFrontParking: Nearby parking may be in front, beside or behind a building and may use either row direction.
AP.Desc.VerticalPreference: Preference when trying layouts, not a guaranteed quota. Geometry, spacing and parking still decide fit.
AP.Desc.SearchStep: Smaller values search more positions and take longer.
AP.Desc.BoundaryGreenMargin: Keep buildings and parking inside this margin. Entrances and pedestrian paths may cross it.
AP.Desc.FrontParkingCoverage: Minimum portion of the building long side overlapping a front parking row in projection. Side bars may share the central court.
AP.ReplacementParking: Replacement would lose required nearby parking.
AP.Desc.RequireBuildingRoad: Off permits extra buildings without a frontage road in this plan. Does not change native building flags or service access. Parking aisles still require a vehicle connection.
AP.Desc.ParkingOrientation: 0: try both; 1: parallel to the main bars; 2: prefer perpendicular rows. When a perpendicular court cannot fit, use a parallel alternative.
AP.Desc.VehiclePassageWidth: Checks a corridor of this width from each parking stall approach to the entrance. Does not simulate a vehicle swept body.
AP.Desc.FrontParkingDistance: Shortest distance between the building lot and a parking row, independent of frontage direction.
AP.BuildingRoadScope: Every building gets the selected internal road across its native frontage, connected to the entrance. Alley is used when AP invisible roads are unavailable.
AP.ParkingAccessIncomplete: Some parking rows lack valid vehicle access. Adjust the layout before saving.
AP.UI.OptionsHint: All dimensions and layout parameters are in game Options, Apartment Plan. They are retained between sessions.
AP.ReplacementFar: Replacement exceeds the enabled FAR limit.
AP.Desc.MainRoadCornerMode: 0: prefer curves, allow right angles when curves cannot fit. 1: curves only. 2: right angles. All modes keep full road width inside the boundary and outside exclusions.
AP.BoundaryDrag: Drag a vertex to edit. Pick an edge to insert a vertex. In entrance mode, click to place a gate.
AP.NoBuildingFit: No selected building fits these conditions. Try a smaller lot, a larger boundary, or adjust spacing in Options.
AP.NativeReady: Preview checked. Confirm placement to build the city objects.
AP.NativeBlocked: Native construction rejected. See details and log.
AP.NativeApplied: Applied. Save the test city to retain changes.
AP.Native.PedestrianWarning: Native pedestrian access warnings remain. Inspect the building entrances and connected paths.
AP.Native.FrontageNeeded: Choose a road supporting building access and reduce the frontage gap.
AP.Native.ParkingNeeded: Some parking bays are not connected to their aisle.
AP.Native.SupplyPending: Actual electricity, water and sewage demand and supply still need inspection.
AP.Native.Details: Details are available in this tooltip and the log.
AP.Native.ParkingPending: Preview checks nearby roads. Actual road, parking and utility connections are inspected after construction.
AP.Desc.SnapClose: Snap to the first vertex to close the polygon.
AP.Desc.ParkingDecalGap: Minimum separation beyond the native decal width. Does not increase the road setback.
AP.InspectPlan: Select this plan to view details or edit it.
AP.LegacyEdit: The original overlay is retained. Add entrances to regenerate an editable layout with current assets and settings.
AP.LegacyUneditable: This plan has no recoverable boundary.
AP.EditingSaved: Editing saved plan. Save updates this plan.
AP.EditPlanHint: Edit the saved layout. Already constructed city objects are not moved or rebuilt.
AP.DeletePlanHint: Delete this plan overlay only. Constructed city objects remain.
AP.Calculating: Calculating layout... You can move the camera.
AP.NetworkUnavailable: The selected road is not ready. Choose an available network; see the prefab initialization log for AP invisible roads.
AP.DeleteBusyHint: Delete the current plan after calculation, construction or demolition finishes. Built compounds must be demolished from their details panel.
AP.DeleteDraftMessage: Discard this unsaved plan and its edits?
AP.Desc.MainParkingSetback: Minimum distance from the main-road edge to buildings and parking bays. Connecting roads may cross.
AP.DeleteDialogMessage: Remove this saved plan from the list? Constructed buildings and roads will remain. Compound management records are retained.
AP.DeleteOwnedPlanHint: Use the plan inspector to demolish the owned complex first.
AP.Villa.NoNearbyRoad: No eligible adjacent road at this boundary point. Check road distance and elevation.
AP.ExistingEntrance: Existing entrance. Right-click nearby to remove it.
AP.Desc.MainRoadCurveLengthPercent: 50 percent halves corner arcs and the S-bend transition span. Straight approaches retain the entrance connection.
AP.BuildSavedHint: Preview actual roads, paths, buildings and parking, then confirm placement.
AP.LegacyBuild: This older plan needs entrances and assets selected before construction. The original overlay stays visible.
AP.DemolishDialogMessage: Remove facilities created by this plan. Only roads verified as newly built are removed. Existing roads and legacy roads without creation records are preserved. Apartment Plan cannot undo this.
AP.DemolishHint: Preview removal of objects created by this plan. Existing surrounding city objects are excluded.
AP.NoOwnership: This older construction has no ownership record. Use the game bulldozer for its objects.
AP.DemolitionReady: Deletion preview checked. Confirm to delete this complex.
AP.DemolitionIncomplete: Some recorded objects remain. Reopen the complex to inspect and retry.
AP.DemolitionForeign: Deletion would affect unowned objects. Cancel and inspect the connected objects.
AP.RoadPending: Apply or discard the pending road design first.
AP.RoadIncomplete: Place the curve endpoint, or undo its control point before applying.
AP.RoadStart: Click a road start point. Right-click undoes the last added road.
AP.RoadControl: Click a curve control point. Right-click cancels the current point.
AP.RoadEnd: Continue from the end point. Click near the last end point again or press Enter to finish.
AP.ManualRoadFit: Road must fit inside the site, clear of reserved zones and edge greenery. Use spans of at least 4 m.
AP.RoadNetworkHint: Uses the selected main-road network and its actual width. Apply road design recalculates buildings and parking once for all drawn segments. Construction still requires preview and Apply.
AP.ParkingDecalMissing: No loaded CSKRParkingDecalClosed1x object was found. See the prefab lookup log.
AP.ParkingDecalRecalculate: Recalculate this plan for the CS KR parking decal size and spacing.
AP.Desc.ParkingGreenIslands: Reserve green strips between parking rows. Off by default; building clearance and decal spacing remain independent.
AP.Desc.ParkingLineOverlap: Bay pitch equals decal width minus line overlap. Default 0.15 m.
AP.PopulationHint: Plan households x sampled residents per occupied city household (refreshed every 60s, up to 4096 samples):
AP.Desc.FlattenTerrain: On construction confirmation, level the site to the FIRST entrance height. Excluded polygons are untouched. Preview/cancel does not change terrain.
AP.NetworkRecalculate: The internal road changed. Recalculate to use its actual width before saving or construction.
AP.Network.Empty: No compatible roads match this filter.
AP.FrontageRecalculate: Some building frontage roads are disconnected from a site entrance or do not cover the building front. Copy the diagnostic report for details.
AP.CopyDiagnostics: Copy diagnostic report (status and relevant logs)
AP.TreesHint: Native preview places trees only in unused green space. Trees belong to the complex and are removed with compound demolition.
AP.GrassHint: Paint unused green space in small batches after building. Grass Sprites saves the shared mask with the city. Compound demolition does not erase the shared mask.
AP.GrassUnavailable: Grass integration could not finish; see log
AP.TileLotsHint: Replace surfaces belonging to new AP buildings only. Original asset files and other buildings are unchanged.
AP.Native.CarJunctionMissing: Vehicle entry or exit lane is missing. See the junction audit.
AP.BuildingPatternHint: Directions follow the site alignment axes, not the camera. Bar modes exclude U and ring templates; spacing, frontage and parking rules still apply.
AP.AllowMainTJunctions: Allow T junctions at extra entrances
AP.AllowMainTJunctionsHint: With three or more entrances, extra gates may join a straight main road at a T junction when its full width fits. Otherwise use the existing connection method.
AP.Tower.Rule.BoundaryTurn: Rotate blocked boundary fronts by 90 degrees
AP.RoadStagePartial: Roads were built, but buildings were not applied. The roads remain owned by this plan.
AP.RoadStageWaiting: Waiting for road and pedestrian lane initialization.
AP.RoadStageHint: Apply builds roads first, then buildings after lane initialization.
AP.EntranceNearbyAdvisory: Another entrance is within 100 m. Additional entrances are not recommended here, but may still be placed.
AP.LayoutReason.Search: No route found under current rules
AP.DeleteAllPlansMessage: Remove all saved plans from the list? Constructed buildings and roads will remain. Compound management records are retained.
AP.Tower.RoutingRetryFit: No road layout met the clearance rules after eight routing orders. Buildings and gates were preserved. Adjust road clearance or the site.
AP.FillHint: Hover between nearby roads, then click to accept the outline. Open sides are closed with straight edges.
AP.FillReady: Click to accept this area and select entrances.
AP.FillEmpty: No suitable area. Move between roads or adjust the search radius.
AP.MigrationReview: Owned AP roads are ready for repair.
AP.MigrationNone: No identifiable AP roads to repair.
AP.MigrationApplied: References updated. Native road rebuilding requested.
AP.RoadPackMissing: The required AP Invisible Road Pack could not be loaded. Have you subscribed to it and enabled it in the current playset? Check that its download has completed, then restart the game. If the problem persists, check the asset loading log.
AP.RoadAssetsInvalid: Some AP road assets are missing or failed initialization. Details were logged.
AP.ParkingInOpenSpace: Use open space for missing parking
AP.ParkingInOpenSpaceHint: Use unreserved green space for connected parking when spaces or parking area are insufficient. Preserves manual zones and boundary greenery. Recalculate to preview.
AP.ReplaceCompoundMessage: Delete this compound’s existing facilities, then prepare the revised layout? Residents will be displaced. Deletion cannot be undone. Nearby facilities are preserved. Check the new preview and confirm placement afterwards.
AP.ReplacementPreparing: Preparing the revised layout after demolition.
AP.ReplacementProtectedRoad: An existing road cannot be safely removed. Replacement was stopped; the compound is unchanged.
AP.ClosePlanMessage: Closing will discard this unsaved plan or changes. Previously saved plans and built facilities will remain. Close without saving?
AP.AutoCalculateHint: Calculate after changes. Turning this back on calculates the current plan.
AP.Villa.PedestrianWarning: Some buildings may lack pedestrian access. Check the construction preview.
AP.DeleteBuilt: Use Demolish entire compound to remove a built compound.
AP.DeleteCalculating: Wait until calculation completes before deleting.
AP.DeletePreview: Exit the construction preview before deleting the plan.
AP.DeleteDialogOpen: Close the current confirmation dialog first.
AP.DeleteNoTarget: No plan is selected for deletion.
AP.Desc.DebugLogging: Record detailed local events for troubleshooting. Off on every game start. Does not enable automatic uploads.
